gaps.quote: A label $U$ is a nondegenerate subspace of $\mathcal F$.
gaps.note: 'Nondegenerate' for a subspace of a space with an indefinite bilinear form is never defined or linked (the form I-J/9 has a negative eigenvalue). The page also never says which bilinear form F carries (the tensor-product form), nor that each line U_iota is nondegenerate (<u,u>=8). Yet the projection P_U along U^perp exists only for nondegenerate U.

gaps.term: rank of P_V-P_U for any labels
gaps.quote: For any labels $U,V$, $P_V-P_U$ is the identity on $V\cap U^\perp$ and zero on $U\oplus V^\perp$, so its rank is $\dim V-\dim U$.
gaps.note: False as stated: it needs U contained in V (nested labels); the paper states it only 'For $U\subset V$ nondegenerate' (paper.tex line 1158). For non-nested labels, e.g. two distinct lines, the rank is not dim V - dim U. The page never says edges join nested labels.

gaps.quote: Each of the $3\binom h3^2$ invocations has $h$ central wires, each losing $h$ on a decreasing edge
gaps.note: The page never describes the three stages, the invocations (the paper has I=3v^2, with v^2 per stage, lines 668-676), the data banks, or the gate order that makes the only decrease the central edge from time 3 to 4 (Lemma, lines 1003-1010). The count 3C(h,3)^2, the h central wires per invocation and the loss h per central wire cannot be checked from the page.

gaps.quote: Sources have dimension $1$, summing to $N$; sinks have dimension $D$, except the $N$ sinks that receive the sources, which have label $U_\iota^\perp$ and dimension $D-1$.
gaps.note: The page never gives the terminal labels (X_a: source U_a, sink F; Y_a: source 0, sink U_a^perp; scratch: source 0, sink F; paper.tex lines 877-893) or says which wires are the N data sources, so these dimension counts and WD-2N cannot be checked.

gaps.term: first edge out of a source
gaps.quote: The first edge out of each source has matrix $2P_{U_\iota}$, rank one, with no label change
gaps.note: The page does not say that the first gate on the source wire has label exactly U_iota (true at stage 1 because B=0; paper.tex lines 1163-1165), so that the edge matrix is P_U-(-P_U)=2P_U. Nor does it say why this edge is an exception to the rank formula.
